criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Per frame 1=7.0, 2=6.8, 3=7.0, 4=6.8, 5=7.3, 6=7.5, 7=7.5, 8=6.0, 9=7.0, taken under the mean because the declared showstopper (8) is the weakest. The bespoke half passes: nine pictures made for nine sentences in distinct worlds, v2 colour everywhere. Craft stops it: 8 is a game-avatar figure with a pale pink kerb and a clip edge slicing the right oak; 3 has a near black instrument block and a stray blue streak; 4 reads as a flat UI graphic with a detached shadow lump; 2's subject is a third of the width under a heavy navy wash; 1's slab top is one peach; 9's outlined block sits over an empty field.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: The spine holds: one palette and grade, fixed type furniture, a real orbit to ground camera move, east right. The accent's one meaning is diluted by peach ground on 1, 5 and 7 and renders pink on 8 and coral on 9. Frame 4's flat column sits slightly outside the rendered worlds.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide numeral traces to figures.json and claims; art counts are asserted in code. Slide 5 states R squared is a fit, slide 8 the ecological limit. Frame 6's three clusters rest on the lead author's interview wording (c7), not the paper's text.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear what happened, where and what it can't say. No county named and no action for a reader; the caption's closing question carries the only civic stake.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays at once, 8 is a real turn and 9 closes on purpose. 3 restates the cover's satellite.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Careful and on register without doom. 'Drawn to illustrate' on all nine reads mechanical; 9's dek is four stacked sentences with a citation; reads as a science desk more than a Texan.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic, palette and land treatment fresh against November 17th. The extruded Texas cover is a familiar opener; 7 and 9's reliefs echo November 14th.

ship_note: No fault found. Under the round 1 rung of 8.0, so a work order for another round, not a hold.
one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 8 around a properly modelled, rim-lit resident filling 45 percent of the height, a true #E0956A kerb running to a visible turned corner, and no haze clip on the right oak.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Game-avatar figure, kerb pale pink with no turned corner, a vertical clip edge slices the right live oak, house washed pink.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A sculpted rim-lit figure, kerb true #E0956A, camera 0.2 m lower so the far corner shows, feather the haze volume causing the clip.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Near black instrument block, a floating blue streak artifact, cellophane foil, the swath hits nothing.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Graphite instrument at L* 25 or more with a cool rim, delete the streak, a sweep floor for the swath to land on with glow and shadow.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Reads as a flat UI graphic; the SO2 band's shadow is a detached lump outside the rail; flat strata.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower raking key so each band casts onto the next and the SO2 shadow falls inside the column; real height on the strata lips.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Station a third of the width, mesa on a ruled cut, navy wash over the top 45 percent reads as a plate.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dolly in, horizon 0.55, mesa base in ground haze, wash thinned to a gradient behind the type only.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slab top one peach, air sheet reads as a clear box, jagged orange fringes on the cut edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Regional low-chroma albedos, a full-state #E0956A glass layer with its own shadow, clip the fringes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No town visible, the outlined block sits over empty field; low-chroma mustard tops.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A town grid averaged to the block's height inside the outline; saturated warm caliche and limestone.
